newsitem.title: BELGIUM: ARBED SAYS DID MAKE OFFER FOR SPAIN'S CSI.
newsitem.headline: ARBED SAYS DID MAKE OFFER FOR SPAIN'S CSI.

text.p: Luxembourg steel maker Arbed SA said on Thursday it did indeed make an offer to become a strategic partner of Spain's state-controlled steel firm Corporation Siderurgica Integral (CSI).

An Arbed spokesman, correcting an Arbed statement made last week, told Reuters "Arbed confirms its interest in the privatisation of CSI and the Luxembourg-based steel company submitted in due time an offer to become a strategic partner of CSI". He declined to give further details.
French steel group Usinor Sacilor said last Friday, the deadline for offers, it was lodging a 3.35 billon French franc offer for 35 percent of CSI.
